title: Exact general relativistic solutions for a cylindrically symmetric stiff fluid matter source
summary: In this work, we derive the general solutions for a cylindrically symmetric space-time filled with a cosmological perfect fluid obeying $p=γρ$ ($0\leq γ\leq 1$), where $γ=1$ represents a stiff or Zeldovich fluid. Using Marder's metric with coefficients depending on $t$ and $r$, we obtain explicit solutions of the gravitational field equations for the three cases $δ= 1, 0, -1$, corresponding to exponential, power-law, and trigonometric behaviors of the metric functions.
